classification.difficultyReason: Direct identification of the opposite rays through the vertex in two-line and three-line diagrams, with no calculation. Same demand as p33-q1.

content.prompt: Identify the vertically opposite angle to $\angle PQR$ in these diagrams.

answer.worked: $QP$ and $QS$ are opposite rays; $QR$ and $QT$ are opposite rays. The vertically opposite angle is $\angle SQT$.
$QP$ and $QU$ are opposite rays; $QR$ and $QV$ are opposite rays. The vertically opposite angle is $\angle UQV$.
$QP$ and $QA$ are opposite rays; $QR$ and $QB$ are opposite rays. The vertically opposite angle is $\angle AQB$.
$QP$ and $QW$ are opposite rays; $QR$ and $QX$ are opposite rays. The vertically opposite angle is $\angle WQX$.
